mandatory_tactical_invariants.rule: Only normal_low_star_catalog operators with identity.rarity 1-3 and qualification.normal_mode=true are legal. Exclude mode-specific reserves; the ordinary three-star catalog count is 17.
Every DEPLOY uses integer [row,col] and an explicit cardinal direction. Forbidden tiles are [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Never exceed eight deployed operators. Verify actual DP, occupancy and cooldown before every deployment.
The conditional no-refund ledger requires Fang income through frame 3570 and Vanilla activations at 750,1653,2556,3459. A missing activation invalidates downstream affordability.
Every replacement requires the predecessor alive until its scheduled retreat, affordable immediate deployment and safe reacquisition. Reject failed handoffs instead of improvising substitutions.
Lancet-2 supplies supported healing and may absorb a patrol strike. Survival of the pioneers through that exchange remains a required gate.

Current simulator ranged fallback selects the nearest eligible operator, with operator_id as tie-breaker, per simulator.py. This supports the screening hypothesis only in the current model; client target priority remains UNKNOWN.
Do not credit unsupported talents, Cardigan self-healing, probability effects, guaranteed splash, refunds or civilian healing.
Manual skills require actual readiness; time-SP recovery pauses during active skills.
Do not withdraw patrol attackers unless the patrol is observed dead. Failure by frame 3759 rejects this candidate.
Clearance actions require exhausted hostile spawns and zero living hostiles. Neutral civilians may remain active during clearance.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Officers can attack civilians within 1.2; verify zero protected-target deaths.
Optional retreat of an already absent Lancet-2 is a no-op; all other unmet fixed-action gates reject the candidate.
WIN requires remaining_life>0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns and no active enemies. Acceptance also requires two civilian arrivals, zero civilian deaths and completion within 600 seconds.

revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Establish four interceptions with inexpensive temporary units, support both opening pioneers with Lancet-2, and replace the lower temporary blocker with Plume before lethal contact. Establish protected medical positions before committing patrol attackers. Preserve both pioneers' demonstrated income dependencies through survival, then replace them with stronger central attackers. Finish with four geometrically verified device-clearance assignments.

revised_strategic_hypotheses.acceptance: Reject on any missed survival, income, readiness, handoff, patrol-death, civilian-protection or completion gate. Static feasibility does not establish WIN.
